work_unit: Prevent frontend and backend authentication-mode drift for guest upload

assessment.risk_override: The behavior crosses the guest-versus-signed-in authorization boundary.

dispatch.scope: Read-only audit of frontend guest upload and backend credential-mode handling
dispatch.outcome: Completed; coordinator inspected the findings before implementation.

implementation.compose: The frontend build derives NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_MODE and self-registration visibility from the corresponding LICENCEIQ server settings, leaving one Compose source of truth.
implementation.ux: An expired signed-in session now returns to the account-or-guest choice with an actionable message instead of silently clearing the session.
implementation.documentation: Docker rebuild guidance and local host-run frontend configuration are clarified.

verification.rendered_compose: The rendered local Compose configuration reports frontend auth mode hybrid and registration true, matching the server configuration.
verification.authorization_tests: Focused offline guest-upload and JWT ownership tests passed: 2 passed.
verification.frontend_checks: Focused Next TypeScript check and Prettier check for auth-gate.tsx passed.
verification.runtime_limitation: Host development processes, rather than Docker containers, currently own ports 3000 and 8000. Docker Desktop restarted during investigation, so the corrected Compose image was not started over those processes.
